sloka: यो हि शत्रुं समुत्पाट्य पार्थिवस्य पुनः क्षये ।न विधत्ते नृपं तत्र नरकं स हि गच्छति ।। ७.६२.१८ ॥
transliteration: yo hi śatruṁ samutpāṭya pārthivasya punaḥ kṣaye ।na vidhatte nṛpaṁ tatra narakaṁ sa hi gacchati ।। 7.62.18 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, whoever uproots an enemy and, in the destruction of that king's domain, does not establish a new ruler there, he certainly goes to hell.
